poll.source_locator: Post body: 'Republican Senator Pete Ricketts leads independent Dan Osborn 50% to 46%, including leaners ... On the initial ballot, Ricketts leads 48% to 44%, with 5% undecided. Mike Marvin, Robin Richards and Chuck Conboy each receive 1%.'; 'The survey of 534 likely voters was conducted October 29–November 1, 2026.'
poll.notes: D slot = Dan Osborn (Independent). Headline is the leaner ballot (50-46); its other/undecided split is not given, so null. Initial ballot (FULL): Osborn 44, Ricketts 48, others 3 (Marvin 1, Richards 1, Conboy 1), undecided 5. Self-funded GrayHouse public poll; align R (founder described as Senate Republican Conference pollster). Release date = 270toWin listing (11/02/2026). MoE +/-4.2. New pollster_id. AUDIT 2026-11-02: switched to the initial ballot without leaners (Osborn 44, Ricketts 48, others 3, undecided 5) so GrayHouse is on the same ballot in IA and NE; recall UNVERIFIED.

pollster.weighting_quote: Weighted to reflect the modeled likely November 2026 electorate in Nebraska. The weights balance gender, age, race, region, urbanicity, party registration and 2024 presidential vote (Trump 56%, Harris 40%). Final weights are calibrated to GrayHouse’s political engagement model, so that voters across the full range of turnout propensity are represented in their expected share of the electorate.
